A small tan and white French Bulldog rests between them on the sofa cushions. (2) The woman turns her head to speak to the man, placing her hand gently on his arm to gain his attention. Her facial expression is soft and expectant as she engages in dialogue. The man turns his head to look at her, still holding his device, displaying a slight smile. The dog remains calm and stationary between the two, looking forward. (4) Suddenly, the woman stands up quickly and exits the frame to the left, leaving her phone behind. The man looks surprised and confused, his eyes wide as he watches her depart. The camera remains static throughout the sequence, capturing the living room environment.
